Load functions and packages

Load the packages and other functions that will be used during reorganisation.

source('HS_functions.R')

Load data

Load the raw data

Load the raw data exported from Excel to csv.

path_file = file.path("0Data",
                      c(#"B22_dances.csv",
                        #"B66_dances.csv",
                        "HD_calib.csv")#horizontal and dome calibrated dances 
)
if(any(!file.exists(path_file)))
{print(paste(path_file, '\nnot found'))}
hd = lapply(X = path_file,
            FUN = read.table,#(file = path_file, 
                header = T, 
                sep  = ',')
hd = do.call(what = rbind,
             args = hd)#HD_calib has different number of columns

Combine calibrated and uncalibrated data

# nm_vert = names(hd)
# nm_calib = names(hd_calib)
# print(nm_calib[!(nm_calib %in% nm_vert)])
# print(nm_vert[!(nm_vert %in% nm_calib)])
#some of these have analogues in nm_vert
# hd_calib = within(hd_calib,
hd = within(hd,
                  {
                    dancer_id = bee_id
                    stimulus = condition
                    rm('bee_id', 'condition')
                  }
                  )

Rename variables

Rename some variables with shorter or easier to recognise names. Video names currently include the full path for the user that annotated them these can be simplified to just file name and folder (date recorded).

hd = within(hd, {
  ID = paste0(dancer_id) # individual identifier
  ID_d = paste0(dance_id, "_", 
                time, "_",
                date) # dance identifier
  day = date # this will need to be converted to POSIX format
  video_file = file.path(basename(dirname(video_name)), #just the folder
                         basename(video_name)) # and file name
  #clean up information that has been doubled
  rm(list = c('dancer_id', 'dance_id', 'dance_key', 'source_batch', "date",
              "video_name", #should be identifiable from video_file
              # "waggle_directions",#split into direction_u  and direction_v
              "start_xy", #split into "start_x" and "start_y" 
              "X21_calibration_11.21.50_waggle_annotations.csv", #unlikely to use later
              "source_file_type", #unlikely to use later
              "orientation_method", #unlikely to use later
              "mean_magnetic_north_deg", # we already have "true_north_video_deg"
              "true_north_calibration_deg", # we already have "true_north_video_deg"
              "compass_circular_sd_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_n_annotations", #unlikely to use later
              "reference_compass_file", #unlikely to use later
              "assigned_calibration_file", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_id", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_file", #unlikely to use later
              "reference_landmark_file", #unlikely to use later
              "landmark_dance_file", #unlikely to use later
              "landmark_calibration_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "landmark_calibration_circular_sd_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "north_relative_to_landmark_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "landmark_dance_video_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "landmark_dance_circular_sd_deg", #unlikely to use later
              "start_frame", #unlikely to use later
              "annotation_session", #unlikely to use later
              "orientation_notes", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_video_name", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_R", #unlikely to use later
              "calibration_notes", #unlikely to use later
              "orientation_block" #unlikely to use later
              ))
})

Identify factor levels

Some of the character variables could be treated as factors. Inspect the different labels to each to check these are informative.

nm_fact = c( "ID",         
 "ID_d"          ,
 # "dance_key"         ,
 # [4,] "waggle_run"        
 "stimulus"         , 
 # "notes"            , 
 # [7,] "waggle_directions" 
#  [8,] "start_x"           
#  [9,] "start_y"           
# [10,] "start_xy"          
# [11,] "csv_file"          
# [12,] "time"              
# [13,] "date"              
# [14,] "direction_u"       
# [15,] "direction_v"       
# [16,] "video_angle_deg"   
# [17,] "start_frame"       
 # "video_name"        
 "video_file" # avoid printing full path        
# [19,] "annotation_session"
# [20,] "source_batch"
            )
sapply(X = hd[, nm_fact],
       unique
     )

Reformat variables

Reformat variables to factor and numeric. Everything else remains character format by default.

nm_num = c(
 #  "dancer_id",         
 # "dance_id"          ,
 # "dance_key"         ,
 "waggle_run",        
 # "stimulus"         , 
 # "notes"            , 
 # [7,] "waggle_directions" 
"start_x"    ,       
"start_y"     ,      
# "start_xy"          
# [11,] "csv_file"          
# [12,] "time"              
# [13,] "date"              
"direction_u",
"direction_v",
"video_angle_deg",
# "start_frame", #removed
 # "video_name"        
#"annotation_session",#removed
# [20,] "source_batch"
"waggle_true_bearing_deg"
)
#format factors
for(nm in nm_fact)
{
hd[, nm] = as.factor(hd[, nm])
}

#format numeric
for(nm in nm_num)
{
hd[, nm] = as.numeric(hd[, nm])
}

summary(hd)

There appears to have been an autofill error in stimulus labelling. Rename all unexpected stimuli to deg_10, 10° above horizontal. 20260818 Has this been fixed? Could skip.

hd = within(hd,
            {
              stimulus = sapply(as.character(stimulus),
                                switch,
                                vertical = "vertical",
                                horizontal = "horizontal",
                                antisolar = "antisolar",
                                solar = "solar",
                                zenith = "zenith",
                                deg_10 = "deg_10",
                                "deg_10")#otherwise always deg_10
            }
            )
with(hd, unique(stimulus))

Check variable structure

Each dance should have only one time code, one stimulus and one bee.

all(
#individuals per dance
summary(
  sapply(X = unique(hd$ID_d),
               FUN = function(id){
                 with(subset(hd, ID_d %in% id),
                          {length(unique(ID))} )
               }
  )
) == 1,
#times per dance
summary(
  sapply(X = unique(hd$ID_d),
               FUN = function(id){
                 with(subset(hd, ID_d %in% id),
                          {length(unique(time))} )
               }
  )
) == 1,
#days per dance
summary(
  sapply(X = unique(hd$ID_d),
               FUN = function(id){
                 with(subset(hd, ID_d %in% id),
                          {length(unique(time))} )
               }
  )
) == 1,
#stimuli per dance
summary(
  sapply(X = unique(hd$ID_d),
               FUN = function(id){
                 with(subset(hd, ID_d %in% id),
                          {length(unique(stimulus))} )
               }
  )
) == 1
)
## [1] TRUE
#how many waggle runs per dance?
summary(
  sapply(X = unique(hd$ID_d),
               FUN = function(id){
                 with(subset(hd, ID_d %in% id),
                          {max(waggle_run)} )
               }
  )
)

Add sun location

Set up times

hd = within(hd,
            {
              time_code = mapply(FUN = paste, 
                                 day,
                                 time)#time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
              sast_time =  as.POSIXct(time_code, 
                                      tz = "Africa/Johannesburg", 
                                      format = "%Y%m%d %H:%M:%OS")#South African Standard time
                                      # format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS")#South African Standard time
              utc_time =  as.POSIXct(sast_time, tz = "UTC")#UTC time
              rm("time_code")#now duplicated
            }
)

Adjust for laptop clock (check this)

Videos recorded on the laptop have time stamps in CET not SAST, so they are one hour behind (South African Summer time is UCT + 2, Central European Winter is UTC + 1). Adjust them by adding one hour before calculating sun position.

hd = within(hd,
            {
              sast_time = as.POSIXct(
                mapply(FUN = switch,
                                 EXPR = stimulus,
                                 vertical = sast_time,
                                 horizontal = sast_time,
                                 deg_10 = sast_time,  
                                 antisolar = sast_time + 60*60, #60 min x 60 seconds
                                 solar = sast_time + 60*60,
                                 zenith = sast_time + 60*60,
                                 sast_time
                                 ),
                tz = "Africa/Johannesburg", 
                format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS")#South African Standard time
              #recalculate UTC time
              utc_time =  as.POSIXct(sast_time, tz = "UTC")#UTC time
            }
            )

Estimate sun location

# Hive position
# 25° 34' 18" S, 31° 10' 48" E
#-25.57167,      31.18000 

hive = r"(25° 34' 18" S, 31° 10' 48" E)" # N.B. this string contains literal " so needs wrapping in r"()"

# Define coordinates (lon, lat)
hive = Dms2decimal(hive) 

#add sun azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            sun_az = mapply(
                   FUN = GetSaz,
                   tm = utc_time,
                   lon = hive['longitude'],
                   lat = hive['latitude']
                   )
            }
            )

#add sun azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            sun_el = mapply(
                   FUN = GetSel,
                   tm = utc_time,
                   lon = hive['longitude'],
                   lat = hive['latitude']
                   )
            }
            )

print(with(hd, sapply(X = list(sun_az, sun_el),FUN =  summary)),
      digits = 2)

Add Feeder angle

# Hive position
# 25° 34' 18" S, 31° 10' 48" E
#-25.57167,      31.18000 

# Feeder position
# 25° 34' 14" S, 31° 10' 59" E
#-25.57056,      31.18306

hive = r"(25° 34' 18" S, 31° 10' 48" E)" # N.B. this string contains literal " so needs wrapping in r"()"

feeder = r"(25° 34' 14" S, 31° 10' 59" E)"

# Define coordinates (lon, lat)
hive = Dms2decimal(hive) 
feeder =  Dms2decimal(feeder)
#N.B. Dms2decimal converts from (latitude, longitude) to (longitude, latitude)
# to conform with geosphere::bearing

# Calculate bearing from hive to feeder
feeder_bearing = bearing(hive, feeder)
print(feeder_bearing, digits = 3)
## [1] 68.2
feeder_distance = distGeo(hive, feeder)
print(feeder_distance, digits = 3)
## [1] 331
#add feeder azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            feeder_az = Mod360.180(feeder_bearing - sun_az)
            }
            )

print(with(hd, summary(feeder_az)), digits = 3)

Format angles

#check angle format

est_err = with(hd, {
    (atan2(y = direction_v, x = direction_u) + pi/2) - rad(video_angle_deg) 
  })
abs_est_err = mod_circular(abs(est_err))
#these can be out by as much as 1/100 of a degree, except two which are out by 90°
hist(x = deg(abs_est_err), 
     breaks = 1e2,
     xlab = 'absolute error in video angle')

cbind(with(hd[abs_est_err > 1,],
     as.character(unique(ID_d))),
          unique(deg(abs_est_err[abs_est_err > 1])) )
##      [,1] [,2]
with(hd[abs_est_err > 1,],
           cbind(
     as.character(unique(ID_d)),
          unique(paste(direction_v, direction_u)), 
     unique(as.character(video_file))
     )
)
##      [,1] [,2] [,3]
#these are zero length vectors
#set them to NA
hd = within(hd, 
            {
              direction_v[direction_v ==0 &
                          direction_u ==0
                          ] = NA
              direction_u[direction_v ==0 &
                          direction_u ==0
                          ] = NA
              video_angle_deg[direction_v ==0 &
                          direction_u ==0
                          ] = NA
            }
            )

#assign angles to numeric

#video_angle_deg is the dance angle clockwise rel to vertical, except  error
hd = within(hd, 
            {
              # bearing = deg(atan2(y = direction_v, x = direction_u) + pi/2) %% 360
              bearing = mapply(FUN = switch,
                               EXPR = stimulus,
                               horizontal = waggle_true_bearing_deg, #corrected with compass
                               deg10 = waggle_true_bearing_deg,
                               vertical =  video_angle_deg, #aligned by default
                               # antisolar = video_angle_deg, #aligned by default
                               # solar = (video_angle_deg +180) %% 360, #misaligned 180°
                               antisolar = waggle_true_bearing_deg, #now calibrated
                               solar = waggle_true_bearing_deg, #now calibrated
                               zenith = waggle_true_bearing_deg, #now calibrated
                               video_angle_deg
                              )
              signed_angle = Mod360.180(bearing)  # bearing between -180 and 180
              # angle = circular(rad(signed_angle),# bearing between -pi and pi
              #                  rotation = 'clock') # circular format suppresses later warnings
              angle = rad(signed_angle)# circular format is not needed for organising
                               
              rm('video_angle_deg')
            }
            )
with(hd, sapply(list(bearing, signed_angle, angle), FUN = summary))

Calculate dance offset from feeder

#assign angles to numeric

#video_angle_deg is the dance angle clockwise rel to vertical, except  error

              abs_feeder_angle_deg = deg(abs(as.numeric(feeder_angle)))# absolute angle in numeric format
            }
            )

)
